result:
I removed the `forceCreate` warning. `PostController.store` now calls `Post.create(data, { set: { authorId: author.id } })`. It destructures any `authorId` out of the request body, so request data can't set the author. In `app/Models/Post.ts` I dropped `authorId` from `fillable`, since `set` throws on a key that is also in `fillable`.

`bun run typecheck`, `bun run lint` and `bun test` still pass. I did not re-run my earlier smoke test against the new `store`, so creating a tagged post is untested after this change.

`guren audit` no longer lists `PostController`. It still reports one failure, a high `source-map-js` advisory, and one `katex` warning. Both are dependency advisories unrelated to this change, so I left them alone.
